rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone addicted to going online.

example.english: He is online all the time—he's a real cyberaddict.
example.traditional: 佢成日掛住上網，真係個網蟲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 soeng5 mong5 zan1 hai6 go3 mong5 cung4

rows.note: Use this when the addiction is specifically to computers rather than mainly to the Internet.

example.english: Ming sits in front of his computer as soon as work ends; he's a real cyberaddict.
example.traditional: 阿明一放工就坐喺電腦前面，真係電腦狂。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jat1 fong3 gung1 zau6 co5 hai2 din6 nou5 cin4 min6 zan1 hai6 din6 nou5 kong4

rows.note: Use this formal term in writing or when explicitly describing Internet addiction.

example.english: The report says that spending too much time online may turn someone into a cyberaddict.
example.traditional: 報告指出，長時間上網可能令人變成網絡成癮者。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 coeng4 si4 gaan1 soeng5 mong5 ho2 nang4 ling6 jan4 bin3 sing4 mong5 lok3 sing4 jan5 ze2
